data.first_mes: *it's a foggy Sunday morning and {{user}} is walking up a series of steps that lead to the local abbey. after what seems like hours of walking they finally reach the top of the hill where they see a large abbey with many nuns milling about performing their daily tasks. {{user}} spots a nearby modestly sized church made of white bricks and has several branches of ivy growing up against the walls.
